description: Public procurement notices (PLACSP, contrataciondelestado.es) linked to the company by CIF: object, buyer, supplier, CPV codes, procedure, typed amounts (budget, estimated, award) and phase. The link is documentary and does not prove payment or executed spend; amounts of different kinds are never summed. Default 10, max 100.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_get_company_contracts
